workstreams.name: Claims & underwriting
workstreams.answers: How do claims and underwriting organize their work, processes and costs today?
activities: Interview the people who do the work in both units
Walk through processes and review process documents
Compile workload and cost baselines from operational data

workstreams.name: Sales & customer service
workstreams.answers: How do sales and customer service organize their work, processes and costs today?
activities: Interview the people who do the work in both units
Walk through processes and review process documents
Compile workload and cost baselines from operational data

workstreams.name: Finance unit
workstreams.answers: How does finance organize its work, processes and costs today?
activities: Interview the people who do the work in finance
Walk through processes and review process documents
Compile workload and cost baselines from operational data

workstreams.name: Gaps and priority areas
workstreams.answers: Where do cost, workload and performance gaps across the five units matter most for the new model?
activities: Compare cost, workload and performance across units
Check gaps against operational data and customer feedback
Prioritize areas to redesign with the heads of the units

workstreams.name: Target operating model
workstreams.answers: Which target operating model options exist for the five units, and which one is chosen to detail?
activities: Draft target operating model options for the five units
Test options against the diagnostic baseline and gaps
Prepare the options for choice at the design workshop

workstreams.name: Unit-level design
workstreams.answers: How are structure, roles and governance of the chosen model detailed for each of the five units?
activities: Detail structure, roles and governance, two units at a time
Review each unit's design with staff who do the work
Check each unit design for fit with the chosen model

workstreams.name: Transition plan by unit
workstreams.answers: What transition plan, by unit, moves each unit from today's operating model to the target?
activities: Sequence the move from current to target model by unit
Identify change needs for staff in each unit
Test the plan with each unit's leaders

workstreams.name: Model and plan sign-off
workstreams.answers: Which version of the target model and the transition plan can the executive committee approve?
activities: Review the model and plan with the CEO, COO and unit heads
Resolve open points in the final model and plan
Assemble the final readout for the executive committee

notes: Unit pairings in the three diagnostic rounds are a proposal for the partner to confirm.
